help.stock: Stock details are optional. Add a stock name, supplier, received date, or stock expenses when you want more complete purchasing and audit records.
help.products: Use a product category when related versions belong together, or record a product without a category. Tunakuza manages SKU identity automatically.
help.catalog: Record products by product category or without a category while Tunakuza manages SKU identity automatically.
help.record: Record quantity and buying cost here. For individually tracked products, add each physical identifier such as an IMEI or serial number.
help.review: Check the products you recorded, then save a draft or receive the stock. Optional stock details are included only when you entered them.
help.familyAssignment: Product category groups related versions of the same product. Different configurations can have different SKUs and Website prices while remaining in one category.
help.autoSku: Record what makes this product configuration different. Tunakuza will reuse a matching SKU or create the needed SKU automatically when the stock is saved.
help.existingSku: If the exact product configuration already exists in this category, select it here. You can also skip this and record another configuration.
help.existingCategory: Choose a product category you already use. Then select an existing product configuration or record another configuration in the same category.
help.newCategory: Create the product category, then record the first product configuration inside it.
help.uncategorized: Use this when you only need a straightforward product record and do not want to organize it under a product category.
